votes.quote: **Raising a session's capacity** (`PATCH /sessions/:id`) doesn't pull people off the waitlist, because the spec only covers cancellations. So after an increase, people can book directly ahead of those waiting, and the waitlisted members still appear in the list. The fix would be to run the same automatic booking from `changeCapacity`.
